Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to set up her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), between 09:00 and 17:00.

Looking at her calendar, she is free at:
- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Would one of those suit you, or do you have another slot in mind? Once you confirm I'll book it and send the invitation.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, on behalf of Professor Alvarez. Monday 10:00-10:30 works: it is free in his calendar and it is inside working hours.

Booked: **Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30 — 1:1 with Sarah** (30 minutes). The invitation is on its way to Sarah; if anything changes, tell me and I'll move it.

See you then.

Confirmed — thank you. **Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30, 1:1 with Sarah** is in her calendar (working hours, nothing else moved). She's away this week but I'm handling her calendar, so if anything needs to change just write to me here.
